comment: Where each title sits on Party Home and in the Library (AVR-155): featured leads, then titles not listed here, then classics, then lab; hidden is not listed at all (its code, contract and install stay). A placement, never a grant: being here does not install, permit or rights-clear anything, and an installed package cannot change its own placement. Empty until the owner decides (D1); the recommended placements are in docs/design/proposals/2026-10-27-catalog-shelves.md section 3. After editing, run python3 -m avrana.contracts.catalog.
